title: The Butterfly Department
summary: Move one small thing a day. Watch eight independent lives change. Trace the consequences, rewind time, and discover what might have happened otherwise.
summaryZhTW: 每天只改變一件微不足道的小事，看八位居民的生活如何悄悄轉變。追查因果、倒轉時間，探索另一種可能。
coverAlt: Original painted editorial-style illustration of Bellwether's bakery, park, library, noticeboard and bus stop, with residents crossing paths beneath the title The Butterfly Department.
controls: Keyboard, mouse and touch. Select a daily intervention, play/pause, 1×/4×, skip to an event or evening; inspect residents, rewind mornings and compare branches. EN/繁中, fullscreen and optional muted-by-default synthesized sound.
limitations: Finite authored five-day fictional simulation, not open social AI or real-world psychological advice. Saves are browser-local with export/import; blocked storage keeps session play. Firefox/WebKit, physical devices, OS minimize/restore, assistive technology and independent human aesthetic review are not verified.

approval.note: Owner-approved 2026-11-09 Design Freeze separately authorizes this exact game and portfolio publication. Core witnesses, Chromium keyboard/touch, EN/zh-TW, recovery and targeted accessibility checks passed. Independent live START, repair and causal archive passed. No owner inspection of final gameplay is claimed. Version 1.0.1 additionally verifies actual bus-route travel and the private appointment deadline.
